title: More than 83.9% of the zeros of the Riemann zeta function are distinct and more than 67.35% are simple and on the critical line
summary: Let N(T) count the nontrivial zeros of the Riemann zeta function up to height T with multiplicity, N_d(T) the distinct ones, and N_0^s(T) those that are simple and on the critical line. We prove liminf N_d(T)/N(T) >= 1645064/1960733 = 0.83900...; earlier work proves 0.83699..., and a report we have not verified claims 0.83805.... Hence more than 67.80% are simple. Also liminf N_0^s(T)/N(T) >= 0.67353...; earlier work proves 0.67250..., and reports we have not verified claim 0.673492.
